security_rules: Tests run only on an authorized dedicated DUT and dedicated test applications.
Security PASS requires enforcement evidence; a crash is not considered a valid security block.
Secure lock-screen tests validate policy without bypassing credentials.
Media permission tests use only media generated by the test harness.
Privacy-toggle tests must restore the original privacy state during teardown/workflow cleanup.
OTA privacy testing requires a saved pre-OTA baseline and a confirmed post-OTA build fingerprint.
No test attempts privilege escalation or access to unrelated application/user data.
